div.head: Abt 66
div.ab: Gif rib forbrocen weorð, III scill' gebete.
Gif rib forbrocen weorð, III scill' gebete.
Gif rib forbrocen weorð, III sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn eine Rippe zerbrochen wird, büsse er 3 Schill.
If a rib is broken, let him pay 3 shillings.
If a rib is broken, 3 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
If a rib becomes broken, let him pay [with] 3 shillings.

note.seg: Dieser Satz stört offenbar den Zusammenhang von 65. 65, 1 mit 67. Die Zahl für die Rippe (s. d. Gl; gleich der für den Zahn oder Daumennagel!) erscheint auffallend klein; doch gibt Ælfred nur ¹/₃ mehr

This sentence evidently interrupts the connection between 65. 65, 1 and 67. The figure for the rib (see that word in Gl; the same as that for a tooth or a thumbnail!) seems remarkably small; yet Ælfred gives only ¹/₃ more

note.label: shillings.
note.seg: §66 seems to have been displaced in the usual top-to-bottom enumeration of the personal injury laws: note that it comes between two clauses concerning injury to the thigh.
